title: Nov 2nd 1/3: Slink Johnson & Cousin Endo
summary: The first surviving November 2 live block is a nearly three-hour launch-day broadcast built around improvisation, merchandise and guests filling a schedule disrupted by the LAX shooting. David Choe opens with illness, technical anxiety and anger at a recently fired worker; the worker, listeners and staff remain private, and hostile workplace claims stay attributed. Bill Poon appears in the recurring driver/sex-industry role. Slink Johnson and his cousin Endo arrive after spending time with Bobby, whose handmade hood pass becomes a running discussion of friendship, belonging, race and the responsibility not to use a slur merely because friends permit it. Slink discusses Lamar in Grand Theft Auto V and an upcoming Black Jesus project. Models Crystal T. Winston and Angelina Ivy present DVDASA merchandise while the room repeatedly comments on their bodies, asks for sexualized poses and pressures them for contact. Their public professional names can identify credited appearances, but social handles, private partners, discovery trails and intimate disclosures are not republished as fan-contact routes. The broadcast preserves their own accounts of adult work, attraction and boundaries without treating occupation, clothing, posing or prior sexual experience as consent. A long discussion of approaching women includes a funny staged supermarket exercise, but also covert photography, a proposed shoe-mounted upskirt camera and arguments that women should tolerate unauthorized images. The archive keeps the ideas and the objections: one participant explicitly distinguishes being asked from having a photograph taken without permission, and another says that covert images can feel violating. The discussion is not converted into surveillance instructions. Race, sexuality, height, age and porn-market claims throughout are banter and stereotype, not demographic evidence. The group plays Trivia with Bobby, launches a small run of shirts, posters and art, explains several designs and previews the next prerecorded Slink/Endo episode. The closing plug and rap include public professional handles in the source; the public reader does not need to reproduce every contact channel. The automatic cleaner removes five empty records only. Five coarse diarization windows and zero turns cannot support named line-level dialogue.
